name: No mates
description: This assembly has a single part with no mates.

name: One revolute mate
description: This assembly has a two parts joined with a revolute mate in the root assembly.

name: One revolute mate in subassembly
description: This assembly has a subassembly with two parts joined with a revolute mate.

name: Joints and a top-Level fixed mate
description: An assembly with subassemblies and joints and a top level fastened mate.

name: Assembly with multiple identical multipart subassemblies
description: An assembly that contains three of the same multipart subassembly. Can be used to look at how IDs of occurrences and instances are generated in the presence of reused subassemblies.
